critical_findings.issue: GroupBy type redefined as union of specific values ('day' | 'week' | 'month' | 'quarter' | 'year') instead of generic string; conflicts with spec and breadcrumb usage patterns
DrillContext interface completely refactored - removed required groupBy field, removed parentValue field, added unspecified tab/metric/value/level fields; breaks drill-down contract from spec
VentasResponse missing breadcrumb field (should be Array<{ label: string; groupBy: GroupBy }>); has unspecified total/totalDocumentos/promedio fields instead

VentasRow completely refactored with different field names and structure (periodo/montoVentas/cantidadDocumentos/tipoDocumento/cliente/vendedor/porcentajeVariacion) vs spec (label/value/salesNet/returnRate/avgDiscount)
DevolucionesResponse missing breadcrumb field; renamed rows→matrix, restructured with unspecified rowLabels/columnLabels/porcentajeTotalVentas fields
DevolucionesMatrixCell completely refactored - removed salesRep/producto/cliente/ratioDevolucion/amountNet fields; replaced with row/column/value/percentage
CxcResponse field names changed (agingBuckets→agingDistribution, overdueShare→porcentajeVencido) and added unspecified saldoTotal/saldoVencido/diasPromediosCobro fields

VendedoresRow completely refactored with Spanish field names (nombre/ventasNetas/devolucionesNetas/tasaDevolucion/clientesActivos/comision/variacionAnual) vs spec English names (name/salesNet/returnsNet/returnRate/collectionRate/avgDiscount)
VendedoresResponse added unspecified totalVentas/totalComisiones/tasaDevolucionPromedio fields; added groupBy field not in spec

ClientesRow completely refactored - removed pareto field entirely, changed all field names to Spanish (nombreCliente/ventasNetas/devolucionesNetas/tasaDevolucion/saldoPendiente/diasAtrasoPromedio/frecuenciaCompra/ultimaCompra), added fields not in spec
ClientesResponse removed paretoThresholds field from spec; added unspecified totalVentas/totalSaldoPendiente/tasaDevolucionPromedio/clientesActivos fields; added groupBy

ProductosRow completely refactored - removed sku/linea/sublinea/rotacion/salesNet/margin; replaced with codigoProducto/nombreProducto/ventasNetas/cantidadVendida/precioPromedio/devolucionesNetas/tasaDevolucion/margenBruto/variacionAnual
ProductosResponse missing breadcrumb field; added unspecified totalVentas/totalCantidad/precioPromedioGlobal/margenBrutoPromedio/tasaDevolucionPromedio aggregates
FinanzasWaterfallStep field names changed (step→label, amount→value); added unspecified isTotal and type fields not in spec
FinanzasResponse renamed waterfall→steps; added unspecified startingBalance/totalInflows/totalOutflows/endingBalance/periodDate/groupBy fields; diverges from spec structure
ExchangeRateRow completely refactored from (yearMonth/rateBcvToUsd) to (fecha/moneda/tasaCompra/tasaVenta/tasaPromedio/volatilidad); changed granularity and meaning

MultimonedaResponse completely restructured; renamed exchangeRates→rates, currentRate→tasaActualUsdBs, added cambioUltimo7Dias/cambioUltimo30Dias/cambioUltimo90Dias/ventasEnMultimoneda nested object; inappropriately added groupBy field to exchange rate response

important_findings.issue: Implementation does not match review package specification in any material way; nearly every interface has been completely refactored with different field names, structures, and purposes, indicating either spec was ignored or work was done against different requirements

minor_findings.issue: FilterParams added groupBy?: GroupBy field and ISO 8601 comments; not in review package spec but reasonable enhancement

strengths: All response types include usdRate: number | null field
Consistent use of nullable fields with | null syntax
All monetary values are raw numbers (not formatted strings)
No logic code present - definitions only
